entries.title: Psalms 119:1
segments: ¶<ALEPH> Happy are they who are without sin in their ways, walking in the law of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 119:2
segments: Happy are they who keep his unchanging word, searching after him with all their heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:3
segments: They do no evil; they go in his ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:4
segments: ¶You have put your orders into our hearts, so that we might keep them with care.

entries.title: Psalms 119:5
segments: If only my ways were ordered so that I might keep your rules!

entries.title: Psalms 119:6
segments: Then I would not be put to shame, as long as I have respect for all your teaching.

entries.title: Psalms 119:7
segments: ¶I will give you praise with an upright heart in learning your right decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:8
segments: I will keep your rules: O give me not up completely.

entries.title: Psalms 119:9
segments: ¶<BETH> How may a young man make his way clean? by guiding it after your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:10
segments: ¶I have made search for you with all my heart: O let me not go wandering far from your teaching.

entries.title: Psalms 119:11
segments: ¶I have kept your sayings secretly in my heart, so that I might do no sin against you.

entries.title: Psalms 119:12
segments: ¶Praise be to you, O Lord: give me knowledge of your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:13
segments: ¶With my lips have I made clear all the decisions of your mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:14
segments: I have taken as much delight in the way of your unchanging word, as in all wealth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:15
segments: I will give thought to your orders, and have respect for your ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:16
segments: I will have delight in your rules; I will not let your word go out of my mind.

entries.title: Psalms 119:17
segments: ¶<GIMEL> Give me, your servant, the reward of life, so that I may keep your word;

entries.title: Psalms 119:18
segments: ¶Let my eyes be open to see the wonders of your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:19
segments: ¶I am living in a strange land: do not let your teachings be kept secret from me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:20
segments: ¶My soul is broken with desire for your decisions at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 119:21
segments: ¶Your hand has been against the men of pride, a curse is on those who go wandering out of your way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:22
segments: ¶Take away from me shame and bitter words; for I have kept your unchanging word in my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:23
segments: ¶Rulers make evil designs against me; but your servant gives thought to your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:24
segments: ¶Your unchanging word is my delight, and the guide of my footsteps.

entries.title: Psalms 119:25
segments: ¶<DALETH> My soul is joined to the dust: O give me life, in keeping with your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:26
segments: ¶I put the record of my ways before you, and you gave me an answer: O give me knowledge of your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:27
segments: Make the way of your orders clear to me; then my thoughts will be ever on your wonders.

entries.title: Psalms 119:28
segments: ¶My soul is wasted with sorrow; give me strength again in keeping with your word

entries.title: Psalms 119:29
segments: Take from me every false way; and in mercy give me your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:30
segments: ¶I have taken the way of faith: I have kept your decisions before me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:31
segments: I have been true to your unchanging word; O Lord, do not put me to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:32
segments: I will go quickly in the way of your teaching, because you have given me a free heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:33
segments: ¶<HE> O Lord, let me see the way of your rules, and I will keep it to the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:34
segments: Give me wisdom, so that I may keep your law; going after it with all my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:35
segments: ¶Make me go in the way of your teachings; for they are my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:36
segments: Let my heart be turned to your unchanging word, and not to evil desire.

entries.title: Psalms 119:37
segments: ¶Let my eyes be turned away from what is false; give me life in your ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:38
segments: ¶Give effect to your word to your servant, in whose heart is the fear of you.

entries.title: Psalms 119:39
segments: ¶Take away the shame which is my fear; for your decisions are good.

entries.title: Psalms 119:40
segments: ¶See how great is my desire for your orders: give me life in your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:41
segments: ¶<VAU> Let your mercies come to me, O Lord, even your salvation, as you have said.

entries.title: Psalms 119:42
segments: So that I may have an answer for the man who would put me to shame; for I have faith in your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:43
segments: ¶Take not your true word quite out of my mouth; for I have put my hope in your decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:44
segments: So that I may keep your law for ever and ever;

entries.title: Psalms 119:45
segments: ¶So that my way may be in a wide place: because my search has been for your orders.

entries.title: Psalms 119:46
segments: So that I may give knowledge of your unchanging word before kings, and not be put to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:47
segments: And so that I may take delight in your teachings, to which I have given my love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:48
segments: And so that my hands may be stretched out to you; and I will give thought to your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:49
segments: ¶<ZAIN> Keep in mind your word to your servant, for on it has my hope been fixed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:50
segments: ¶This is my comfort in my trouble; that your sayings have given me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:51
segments: ¶The men of pride have made great sport of me; but I have not been turned from your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:52
segments: ¶I have kept the memory of your decisions from times past, O Lord; and they have been my comfort.

entries.title: Psalms 119:53
segments: ¶I am burning with wrath, because of the sinners who have given up your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:54
segments: ¶Your rules have been melodies to me, while I have been living in strange lands.

entries.title: Psalms 119:55
segments: ¶I have given thought to your name in the night, O Lord, and have kept your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:56
segments: This has been true of me, that I have kept your orders in my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:57
segments: ¶<CHETH> The Lord is my heritage: I have said that I would be ruled by your words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:58
segments: ¶I have given my mind to do your pleasure with all my heart; have mercy on me, as you have said.

entries.title: Psalms 119:59
segments: ¶I gave thought to my steps, and my feet were turned into the way of your unchanging word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:60
segments: I was quick to do your orders, and let no time be wasted.

entries.title: Psalms 119:61
segments: ¶The cords of evil-doers are round me; but I have kept in mind your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:62
segments: ¶In the middle of the night I will get up to give you praise, because of all your right decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:63
segments: ¶I keep company with all your worshippers, and those who have your orders in their memory.

entries.title: Psalms 119:64
segments: ¶The earth, O Lord, is full of your mercy: give me knowledge of your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:65
segments: ¶<TETH> You have done good to your servant, O Lord, in keeping with your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:66
segments: Give me knowledge and good sense; for I have put my faith in your teachings.

entries.title: Psalms 119:67
segments: ¶Before I was in trouble I went out of the way; but now I keep your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:68
segments: ¶You are good, and your works are good; give me knowledge of your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:69
segments: ¶The men of pride have said false things about me; but I will keep your orders in my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:70
segments: Their hearts are shut up with fat; but my delight is in your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:71
segments: ¶It is good for me to have been through trouble; so that I might come to the knowledge of your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:72
segments: ¶The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

entries.title: Psalms 119:73
segments: ¶<JOD> Your hands have made me, and given me form: give me wisdom, so that I may have knowledge of your teaching.

entries.title: Psalms 119:74
segments: ¶Your worshippers will see me and be glad; because my hope has been in your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:75
segments: ¶I have seen, O Lord, that your decisions are right, and that in unchanging faith you have sent trouble on me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:76
segments: ¶Let your mercy now be my comfort, as you have said to your servant.

entries.title: Psalms 119:77
segments: Let your gentle mercies come to me, so that I may have life; for your law is my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:78
segments: ¶Let the men of pride be shamed; because they have falsely given decision against me; but I will give thought to your orders.

entries.title: Psalms 119:79
segments: Let your worshippers be turned to me, and those who have knowledge of your words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:80
segments: ¶Let all my heart be given to your orders, so that I may not be put to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:81
segments: ¶<CAPH> My soul is wasted with desire for your salvation: but I have hope in your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:82
segments: My eyes are full of weariness with searching for your word, saying, When will you give me comfort?

entries.title: Psalms 119:83
segments: ¶For I have become like a wine-skin black with smoke; but I still keep the memory of your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:84
segments: ¶How short is the life of your servant! when will you give your decision against those who are attacking me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:85
segments: ¶The men of pride, who are turned away from your law, have put nets for me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:86
segments: All your teachings are certain; they go after me with evil design; give me your help.

entries.title: Psalms 119:87
segments: They had almost put an end to me on earth; but I did not give up your orders.

entries.title: Psalms 119:88
segments: ¶Give me life in your mercy; so that I may be ruled by the unchanging word of your mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:89
segments: ¶<LAMED> For ever, O Lord, your word is fixed in heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 119:90
segments: Your faith is unchanging from generation to generation: you have put the earth in its place, and it is not moved.

entries.title: Psalms 119:91
segments: They are ruled this day by your decisions; for all things are your servants.

entries.title: Psalms 119:92
segments: ¶If your law had not been my delight, my troubles would have put an end to me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:93
segments: ¶I will ever keep your orders in mind; for in them I have life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:94
segments: ¶I am yours, O be my saviour; for my desire has been for your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:95
segments: ¶The sinners have been waiting for me to give me up to destruction; but I will give all my mind to your unchanging ward.

entries.title: Psalms 119:96
segments: ¶I have seen that nothing on earth is complete; but your teaching is very wide.

entries.title: Psalms 119:97
segments: ¶<MEM> O what love I have for your law! I give thought to it all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 119:98
segments: ¶Your teaching has made me wiser than my haters: for it is mine for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:99
segments: I have more knowledge than all my teachers, because I give thought to your unchanging word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:100
segments: I have more wisdom than the old, because I have kept your orders.

entries.title: Psalms 119:101
segments: ¶I have kept back my feet from all evil ways, so that I might be true to your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:102
segments: ¶My heart has not been turned away from your decisions; for you have been my teacher.

entries.title: Psalms 119:103
segments: ¶How sweet are your sayings to my taste! truly, they are sweeter than honey in my mouth!

entries.title: Psalms 119:104
segments: Through your orders I get wisdom; for this reason I am a hater of every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:105
segments: ¶<NUN> Your word is a light for my feet, ever shining on my way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:106
segments: ¶I have made an oath and kept it, to be guided by your upright decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:107
segments: ¶I am greatly troubled, O Lord, give me life in keeping with your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:108
segments: ¶Take, O Lord, the free offerings of my mouth, and give me knowledge of your decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:109
segments: ¶My soul is ever in danger; but I still keep the memory of your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:110
segments: Sinners have put a net to take me; but I was true to your orders.

entries.title: Psalms 119:111
segments: ¶I have taken your unchanging word as an eternal heritage; for it is the joy of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:112
segments: My heart is ever ready to keep your rules, even to the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:113
segments: ¶<SAMECH> I am a hater of men of doubting mind; but I am a lover of your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:114
segments: ¶You are my secret place and my breastplate against danger; my hope is in your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:115
segments: ¶Go far from me, you evil-doers; so that I may keep the teachings of my God.

entries.title: Psalms 119:116
segments: ¶Be my support as you have said, and give me life; let not my hope be turned to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:117
segments: Let me not be moved, and I will be safe, and ever take delight in your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:118
segments: ¶You have overcome all those who are wandering from your rules; for all their thoughts are false.

entries.title: Psalms 119:119
segments: All the sinners of the earth are like waste metal in your eyes; and for this cause I give my love to your unchanging word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:120
segments: My flesh is moved for fear of you; I give honour to your decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:121
segments: ¶<AIN> I have done what is good and right: you will not give me into the hands of those who are working against me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:122
segments: Take your servant's interests into your keeping; let me not be crushed by the men of pride.

entries.title: Psalms 119:123
segments: ¶My eyes are wasted with desire for your salvation, and for the word of your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:124
segments: ¶Be good to your servant in your mercy, and give me teaching in your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:125
segments: I am your servant; give me wisdom, so that I may have knowledge of your unchanging word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:126
segments: ¶It is time, O Lord, for you to let your work be seen; for they have made your law without effect.

entries.title: Psalms 119:127
segments: ¶For this reason I have greater love far your teachings than for gold, even for shining gold.

entries.title: Psalms 119:128
segments: Because of it I keep straight in all things by your orders; and I am a hater of every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:129
segments: ¶<PE> Your unchanging word is full of wonder; for this reason my soul keeps it.

entries.title: Psalms 119:130
segments: ¶The opening of your words gives light; it gives good sense to the simple.

entries.title: Psalms 119:131
segments: ¶My mouth was open wide, waiting with great desire for your teachings.

entries.title: Psalms 119:132
segments: ¶Let your eyes be turned to me, and have mercy on me, as it is right for you to do to those who are lovers of your name.

entries.title: Psalms 119:133
segments: ¶Let my steps be guided by your word; and let not sin have control over me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:134
segments: ¶Make me free from the cruel rule of man; then I will keep your orders.

entries.title: Psalms 119:135
segments: ¶Let your servant see the shining of your face; give me knowledge of your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:136
segments: ¶Rivers of water are flowing from my eyes, because men do not keep your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:137
segments: ¶<TZADE> O Lord, great is your righteousness, and upright are your decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:138
segments: You have given your unchanging word in righteousness, and it is for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:139
segments: ¶My passion has overcome me; because my haters are turned away from your words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:140
segments: ¶Your word is of tested value; and it is dear to your servant.

entries.title: Psalms 119:141
segments: ¶I am small and of no account; but I keep your orders in mind.

entries.title: Psalms 119:142
segments: ¶Your righteousness is an unchanging righteousness, and your law is certain.

entries.title: Psalms 119:143
segments: ¶Pain and trouble have overcome me: but your teachings are my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:144
segments: The righteousness of your unchanging word is eternal; give me wisdom so that I may have life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:145
segments: ¶<KOPH> I have made my prayer with all my heart; give answer to me, O Lord: I will keep your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:146
segments: My cry has gone up to you; take me out of trouble, and I will be guided by your unchanging word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:147
segments: ¶Before the sun is up, my cry for help comes to your ear; my hope is in your words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:148
segments: In the night watches I am awake, so that I may give thought to your saying.

entries.title: Psalms 119:149
segments: ¶Let my voice come to you, in your mercy; O Lord, by your decisions give me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:150
segments: ¶Those who have evil designs against me come near; they are far from your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:151
segments: You are near, O Lord; and all your teachings are true.

entries.title: Psalms 119:152
segments: ¶I have long had knowledge that your unchanging word is for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:153
segments: ¶<RESH> O see my trouble, and be my saviour; for I keep your law in my mind,

entries.title: Psalms 119:154
segments: Undertake my cause, and come to my help, give me life, as you have said.

entries.title: Psalms 119:155
segments: ¶Salvation is far from evil-doers; for they have made no search for your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:156
segments: ¶Great is the number of your mercies, O Lord; give me life in keeping with your decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:157
segments: ¶Great is the number of those who are against me; but I have not been turned away from your unchanging word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:158
segments: ¶I saw with hate those who were untrue to you; for they did not keep your saying.

entries.title: Psalms 119:159
segments: ¶See how great is my love for your orders: give me life, O Lord, in keeping with your mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 119:160
segments: ¶Your word is true from the first; and your upright decision is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:161
segments: ¶<SHIN> Rulers have been cruel to me without cause; but I have the fear of your word in my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:162
segments: ¶I am delighted by your saying, like a man who makes discovery of great wealth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:163
segments: ¶I am full of hate and disgust for false words; but I am a lover of your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:164
segments: ¶Seven times a day do I give you praise, because of your upright decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 119:165
segments: ¶Great peace have lovers of your law; they have no cause for falling.

entries.title: Psalms 119:166
segments: ¶Lord, my hope has been in your salvation; and I have kept your teachings.

entries.title: Psalms 119:167
segments: ¶My soul has kept your unchanging word; great is my love for it.

entries.title: Psalms 119:168
segments: I have been ruled by your orders; for all my ways are before you.

entries.title: Psalms 119:169
segments: ¶<TAU> Let my cry come before you, O Lord; give me wisdom in keeping with your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:170
segments: Let my prayer come before you; take me out of trouble, as you have said.

entries.title: Psalms 119:171
segments: ¶Let my lips be flowing with praise, because you have given me knowledge of your rules.

entries.title: Psalms 119:172
segments: ¶Let my tongue make songs in praise of your word; for all your teachings are righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:173
segments: ¶Let your hand be near for my help; for I have given my heart to your orders.

entries.title: Psalms 119:174
segments: All my desire has been for your salvation, O Lord; and your law is my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:175
segments: ¶Give life to my soul so that it may give you praise; and let your decisions be my support.

entries.title: Psalms 119:176
segments: ¶I have gone out of the way like a wandering sheep; make search for your servant; for I keep your teachings ever in mind.
